title: Collection of the Retiree Contribution on the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans
content:
A group contract in the Employer and Union Group Retiree Plans book offers the retiree a stated set of ways for their monthly share to be collected, and fixes the number of months a pension deduction takes to begin after it is set up.

| Group plan | Ways the retiree's share may be collected | Months a pension deduction takes to begin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Standard (PPO) | Pension deduction; direct bill | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Enhanced (PPO) | Pension deduction; direct bill; electronic funds transfer | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) | Pension deduction; direct bill; electronic funds transfer; bulk remittance by the sponsor | 1 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Standard (EGWP) | Pension deduction; direct bill | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Enhanced (EGWP) | Pension deduction; direct bill; electronic funds transfer | 2 |
| Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP) | Pension deduction; direct bill; electronic funds transfer; bulk remittance by the sponsor | 1 |

## Points of judgement on the schedule

Pension deduction and direct bill stand on every plan of the book. Electronic funds transfer stands on four of the six, and bulk remittance by the sponsor on two only: Ridgecrest Group Retiree Premium (PPO) and Ridgecrest Group Retiree Rx Premium (EGWP).

The lead time is counted in whole months from the setting up of the deduction. It stands at 1 month on those same two plans and at 2 months on the remaining four, so the plans that offer the widest choice of collection are also the plans on which a deduction begins soonest.
